run_training_mnist: run training on MNIST dataset with a multi-layer encoder and single-layer decoder for continual learning
test_training_run_training: test the run_training function with MNIST dataset using sequential training data and fixed replay
run_training_custom_encoder: run training with a custom multi-layer encoder configuration specifying layer sizes and strides
run_training_supervised: run training with supervised learning enabled and supervised replay for classification tasks
test_training_dynamic_expansion: test training with dynamic expansion enabled and a log-likelihood threshold for continual learning
